title: Polyfans
tagline: A decentralized version of Patreon for web3 creators and their fans
description:
A decentralized version of Patreon for web3 creators and their fans.
Authors can make their content exclusive to users that follow them or bought this content as NFT. Or they can specify any on-chain condition to unlock the content of a particular posts.
In future we are going to add a possibility to communicate with fans via encrypted messages and add livestreaming.

Polyfans NFTs can also be used by other apps. For example a creator can give access to a private Discord group to his fans.
how_its_made:
1. Polyfans uses Lens Protocol under the hood. All entities are NFTs: 
creators' profiles, posts, comments. All content and metadata is stored on IPFS

2. To get access to exclusive content from creators a user has to get followNFT or collect post's NFT or fits any other on-chain conditions specified by the creator

3. Exclusive posts are encrypted using Lit protocol and user can view it if appropriate on-chain conditions are met

4. Frontend is deployed to Spheron
